user.title: Connect WhatsApp HA
user.description: Connect WhatsApp HA to your WWebJS API server. Sessions will be discovered automatically.

data_description.url: Base URL reachable from Home Assistant, for example http://192.168.1.20:3000.
data_description.api_key: The API_KEY configured on the WWebJS API server.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure WhatsApp HA
reconfigure.description: Update the server URL or API key. The connection is tested before the entry is saved.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate WhatsApp HA
reauth_confirm.description: The saved API key was rejected. Enter the current API key for the WWebJS API server.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the WWebJS API server

abort.already_configured: This WWebJS API server is already configured
abort.cannot_connect: The YAML configuration could not be imported because the WWebJS API server could not be reached
abort.invalid_auth: The YAML configuration could not be imported because the API key was rejected
abort.reauth_successful: The WhatsApp HA API key was updated successfully
abort.reconfigure_successful: The WhatsApp HA connection was updated successfully

search_contacts.name: Search contacts
search_contacts.description: Return contacts from a WhatsApp session whose identity fields match a Python regular expression. Every JSON attribute supplied by the contacts API is preserved on each matching contact, including nested ID data, booleans, labels, names, number and future fields.

config_entry_id.name: WhatsApp HA connection
config_entry_id.description: The WhatsApp HA configuration entry that connects to the WWebJS API server.

session_id.name: Session ID
session_id.description: The WWebJS session to search, for example default or personal.

pattern.name: Regular expression
pattern.description: Python regular expression matched against name, pushname, shortName, verifiedName, number, and contact ID fields. Use (?i) for case-insensitive matching. Matching contacts are returned with all API attributes unchanged.

invalid_config_entry.message: The selected WhatsApp HA configuration entry is invalid.

config_entry_not_loaded.message: The selected WhatsApp HA configuration entry is not loaded.
